Frontend: change-password E2E PASS (admin password restored to Trillion@Master2026), admin Settings test-stripe + test-email buttons PASS, AppForge workbench tabs+editor+save+refine UI PASS. CRITICAL frontend regression: AppForge Preview iframe cannot render because global security_headers middleware in server.py:527 forces X-Frame-Options: DENY on every response, clobbering the SAMEORIGIN header set inside the /appforge/preview/{gen_id} handler. Secondary issue: preview endpoint requires Authorization header via get_current_user, but iframes never send Authorization; the src URL cannot authenticate → 401 for logged-in users too when hit from the iframe context (browser only sends cookies, not custom Auth headers).

minor.issue: Response body does not include the parent_gen_id / 'parent' field even though it is stored in the DB. Spec says 'Response includes parent link' — currently only download_url is returned. Frontend/API consumers cannot show parent linkage without extra GET.
Global X-Frame-Options: DENY overrides per-response headers. Route-level overrides (e.g. /appforge/preview → SAMEORIGIN) are lost. Middleware should only set the header if the route did not already.

ui_bugs.issue: iframe fails with 'Refused to display ... X-Frame-Options: DENY'. Root cause is global security_headers middleware (backend). Fix: in server.py middleware, do NOT overwrite X-Frame-Options if the response already has it (`resp.headers.setdefault(...)`). Also the endpoint's CSP is fine, but Cache-Control: no-store is being kept.

Preview endpoint uses get_current_user which reads Authorization header. iframe src cannot carry an Authorization header (browsers only send cookies to iframes). Even after fixing X-Frame-Options, an unauthenticated iframe request will return 401 and the iframe will still be blank. Fix options: (a) accept a short-lived signed token in the URL query, (b) accept auth from httpOnly cookie, or (c) make preview public-readable behind an unguessable gen_id.

Include parent_gen_id in the POST /api/appforge/refine response body (spec: 'Response includes parent link').

rca of the issue: Symptom: workbench Preview iframe is blank; browser console: 'Refused to display ... in a frame because it set X-Frame-Options to deny'. RCA #1: /app/backend/server.py:523-530 registers a global HTTP middleware that unconditionally sets X-Frame-Options: DENY on every response, running AFTER the endpoint handler. The /appforge/preview endpoint (appforge.py:432) tries to set X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, but the outer middleware overwrites it. Fix: `resp.headers.setdefault('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY')`. RCA #2: Even after fixing frame headers, the iframe src '/api/appforge/preview/{gen_id}' still fails because it requires Authorization: Bearer <jwt> via Depends(get_current_user), and iframes cannot send Authorization headers (no JS control over subresource requests). Fix: accept auth from either (a) query-string signed token, or (b) a cookie set at login. Verified locally: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' /api/appforge/preview/<gen_id>` returns 200 text/html correctly, so the endpoint logic itself is fine.
